FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Big & Little Letters Together

Twenty-six cards showing each big letter and its little letter side by side — Aa to Zz — the classic first matching pair for preschool hands and eyes.

THE CARDS

All twenty-six.

Right here on this page — the full-size card, the words to say together, and the download, print and share buttons.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Little ways that work.

  1. 01

    Start small

    Pick three cards and lay them face up. Three cards is a lovely little class — the whole alphabet can wait.

  2. 02

    Follow the arrows

    Say the letter, say its sound, then say it again on the way to snack. All three in under ten seconds is exactly right.

  3. 03

    Tape one up

    Put today’s card at eye level — the fridge, a door. Passing it again and again is quietly powerful practice.

  4. 04

    Match the sets

    Lay a card from this set beside the same card from another letter set and let your child find the pair. The same letter keeps showing up, wearing different clothes.

      FLASHCARD · BIG & LITTLE LETTERS · AGES 3–4 YEARS

      Letter Aa Flashcard — Big and Little A Together

      Big A, little a — the two faces of the same letter, side by side on one card. Say the letter’s name, then spot the big one and the little one.

      Download card ↓

      Teaching tips

      Say it together

      “Big A, little a. Say the letter’s name together — “A!””

      Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the letter, the word, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

      Try this

      Say the letter’s name, then ask “which one is the little a?” Matching big to little is a real pre-reading skill — and a quiet two-minute game.
